summary.en: Connect a position-aware lexer, recursive-descent parser, AST evaluator and TAC generator for a small integer expression language.
summary.bn: তুমি লেক্সার, পার্সার, AST, ইভ্যালুয়েটর আর TAC জুড়ে ছোট ক্যালকুলেটর কম্পাইলার চালাবে।

notes: Python programs use the standard library and were executed with Python 3.12.14.

examples.title: Run the entire numeric pipeline
examples.explanationHtml: The same AST drives evaluation to 2 and generation of product-before-subtraction TAC.

examples.title: Compile with an explicit name environment
examples.explanationHtml: Evaluation resolves marks, while TAC keeps marks as a named input operand.

examples.title: Diagnose lexical, syntax and name errors
examples.explanationHtml: Each request reports its first failing phase; parser and scanner positions identify the damaged source location.

practice.title: Build the numeric calculator interface
practice.statementHtml: Read one numeric expression, at most 100 characters and 30 nested operations, using the project grammar. Print Calculator expression:, then value = INTEGER and the TAC display from the lesson. If a phase fails, print error: followed by its LanguageError message and no value or TAC. Unary operators print negated operands as shown in the TAC topic.
hints: Complete parsing and evaluation before displaying a result.

practice.title: Explain phase boundaries
practice.statementHtml: State the input, output and error responsibility of the scanner, parser, evaluator and TAC generator.
hints: A valid prefix is not necessarily a complete expression.
practice.answerHtml:
Pipeline contracts
PhaseInputOutputFailure kind
ScannerSource charactersPositioned tokens plus end markerUnexpected character
ParserToken listOne complete ASTExpected operand or punctuation; trailing token
EvaluatorAST and environmentInteger valueUnknown identifier
TAC generatorASTQuadruple rows and final operandValid AST required

Token positions are one-based line and character column. A tab counts as one character, not a visual tab-stop width. The scanner accepts whitespace including newlines. The parser requires the end marker after its expression, so it rejects 2 3 rather than returning the first number and ignoring the rest.

practice.title: Plan a division extension
practice.statementHtml: List every phase and semantic decision that must change to add division and then assignment.
hints: Extend the language contract before implementing a new operator.
practice.answerHtml:
Adding division requires decisions beyond putting / in the scanner. Choose integer or real division, define negative-operand behaviour, specify zero-divisor errors, add parser precedence, evaluator semantics and a TAC operation. Update all consumers of the AST rather than letting one phase accept an operation another phase cannot handle.

Adding assignment requires a statement grammar and a writable environment. Decide when declarations happen and whether reassignment may change a name's type. A symbol table can keep declaration information, while a runtime environment keeps values. They are related maps with different jobs and should not be silently treated as one universal dictionary.

Adding typed real values would connect this project to the earlier type checker. A typed AST could insert int-to-real conversion nodes before TAC generation. If the generator instead guesses types from printed token strings, it will lose the semantic decisions made earlier.

Large inputs need explicit resource limits. Recursive descent and recursive AST processing can reach Python's recursion limit. The practice interface limits expression length to 100 characters and nesting to 30. These limits are suitable for classroom arithmetic, not a claim that the compiler handles arbitrarily deep untrusted programs.

options: Subtraction with a multiplication right child
quiz.explanation: The parser gives multiplication higher precedence than subtraction.

quiz.prompt: Why reject 2 3 after parsing its first number?
options: An extra token remains before end
The evaluator needs two operands always
quiz.explanation: The parser must consume the complete input expression.

quiz.prompt: Why keep marks as an input operand in generated TAC?
options: The compiled expression can run with different environments
quiz.explanation: Evaluation values and compilation operands are separate unless a constant proof allows substitution.

quiz.prompt: What distinguishes neg from binary subtraction in the AST?
quiz.explanation: Arity and operation tags preserve unary versus binary meaning.
Every consuming phase needs an agreed operation meaning, not just a token.

quiz.prompt: Why avoid running source arithmetic as host-language code?
options: The supported source language must stay explicit
quiz.explanation: Dispatching known AST tags keeps evaluation within the intended language.

quiz.prompt: Which failure is semantic rather than lexical or syntactic here?
quiz.explanation: The name is a valid token and expression leaf but lacks a supplied meaning.

quiz.prompt: Why reserve all source names before allocating TAC temporaries?
options: Every name must become a constant
A source name such as t1 must not collide
quiz.explanation: Internal result names need identities distinct from existing source operands.

quiz.prompt: When should the interface print a value?
options: After complete parsing and successful evaluation
quiz.explanation: Printing only on success avoids presenting partial output as a compiled result.

keyPoints.en: The parser must consume the end token after one expression.
keyPoints.bn: একটি এক্সপ্রেশন পার্স করে শেষে end টোকেনও মিলাও।

keyPoints.en: One AST can support both evaluation and TAC generation.
keyPoints.bn: একই AST দিয়ে মান বের করা আর TAC লেখা দুটোই করা যায়।

keyPoints.en: The evaluator receives identifier values explicitly.
keyPoints.bn: নামের মান ইভ্যালুয়েটরকে আলাদা environment দিয়ে জানাও।

keyPoints.en: Every language extension needs matching changes in all affected phases.
keyPoints.bn: নতুন ফিচার দিলে যেসব ফেজে দরকার, সবগুলোতেই মিল রেখে বদলাও।

keyPoints.en: Source positions help distinguish lexical and syntax failures.
keyPoints.bn: সোর্সের লাইন আর কলাম দেখালে লেক্সার ও পার্সারের ভুল খুঁজতে সুবিধা হয়।
